{{Top|leg}}
The '''Botrut''' were one of three prominent tribes of the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] species from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]]. The other two known tribes were the [[Isced]] and the [[Irden]]. [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] brought many Botrut Ugnaughts to his [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]]-mining facilities in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the nearby planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].
